19.name: about
19.excerpt: For the over 40 years, we have been at the forefront of revolutionizing micro-manufacturing technologies.

96.name: materials
96.excerpt: Potomac has deep experience in all common materials, including Kapton polymers and a range of metals, plastics, ceramics, and more.  Our engineers will work with you to select the proper material for your project.

10956.name: pressure-sensitive-adhesives
10956.excerpt: DuPont Kapton polyimide films are among the most versatile materials available and are extensively used in industries such as medical, biotech, aerospace, automotive, and photovoltaics.

108.name: glass
108.excerpt: Utilizing high accuracy motion systems, Potomac is capable of holding very tight positional tolerances across very large parts.  Line widths can be as narrow as 10 microns depending on the type of glass.

8433.name: kapton-polyimide
8433.excerpt: DuPont Kapton polyimide films are among the most versatile materials available and are extensively used in industries such as medical, biotech, aerospace, automotive, and photovoltaics.

5550.name: metal
5550.excerpt: Potomac has a broad range of tools that are capable of machining extremely precise features in almost any type of metal material.

2502.name: plastics
2502.excerpt: Potomac Photonics has a broad range of technologies and processes to micromachine almost any type of polymer material on the market.

1668.name: polymers
1668.excerpt: Potomac has the unique capability to custom cut practically every type of polymer material quickly and cost effectively.  Parts with complex designs and small features can be processed in many cases within 24-48 hours of receiving your drawing.

2152.name: stainless-steel
2152.excerpt: There are many factors that determine the appropriate machining technology to use when fabricating parts in stainless steel.  Most critical among these factors are the thickness of the part, the desired feature sizes, and the cut quality requirements.

10958.name: thin-metal-foils
10958.excerpt: DuPont Kapton polyimide films are among the most versatile materials available and are extensively used in industries such as medical, biotech, aerospace, automotive, and photovoltaics.

Before joining Goodfellow, Simon spent 24 years at RS Components in sales, purchasing and product management. In 2010 he moved to Noida, India, on a one-year secondment to an RS joint venture, then led the Emerging Markets and Export team covering countries including Russia, Kazakhstan, Saudi Arabia and Israel.

Simon joined Goodfellow in 2016 with responsibility for strategic sales growth, sales planning, business development and the sales teams. Following the acquisition of the business by Battery Ventures in September 2021, he moved into the CEO role. He lives in Northamptonshire with his family and supports the Northampton Saints rugby team.

Andrew has held senior finance positions for 15 years, qualifying through industry while studying in the evenings and at weekends. Before joining Goodfellow in 2016 he specialised in turnarounds, as Finance Director for a regional law firm and previously Group Financial Controller for a large motor retail group.

He is responsible for all financial aspects of the business and, alongside Simon, the creation and delivery of the growth strategy, and line manages the Finance and HR functions. Andrew is a Chartered Management Accountant and lives in Nottinghamshire with his family.

Mike joined Potomac as a Sales and Marketing Administrator for what was then a fledgling contract manufacturing group. As that business grew, he built the Quality System, became a certified Lead Assessor through the Maryland ISO Consortium, and led Potomac to ISO 9001:2000 certification in January 2004 and ISO 13485:2003 certification a few years later.

To understand every part of quality, Mike became proficient with Potomac's laser technologies: assembling production laser systems, creating programs, developing customer applications in R&D and production, and training technicians. He moved into the role of Director of Operations and now leads the upgrade of the facility. Outside work he spends time with his family, plays sport and enjoys the occasional trip to Canada.
